nodes.rationale: Backend is not just CRUD; Python ecosystem for AI/ML/NLP/LLM, FastAPI for async, OpenAPI docs, Pydantic typing, modular business/AI/integration logic.

nodes.label: Admin Panel (Knowledge Management System)
nodes.rationale: Business team controls what Wishtrip knows; business-controlled knowledge + AI intelligence rather than letting AI decide everything.

nodes.label: Location Entity Data Model
nodes.rationale: Store context about places (travel info, characteristics, qualitative knowledge, media), not just places, to feed the AI.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph of Location Relationships
nodes.rationale: Recommendations are fundamentally about relationships (NEAR, ROUTE, SUITABLE_FOR, REQUIRES, BEST_TIME).

nodes.label: Defer Graph Database Decision
nodes.rationale: Model graph conceptually from day one but use PostgreSQL for MVP; avoid another operational system until relationship traversal complexity requires Neo4j.

nodes.label: Traveler Profile & User Intelligence
nodes.rationale: Combines explicit, behavioral and historical information into a Traveler Preference Profile.

nodes.label: AI/ML Recommendation Architecture
nodes.rationale: LLM is not the recommendation engine; database = what exists, recommendation engine = what is relevant, AI = combine/explain/personalize.

nodes.label: AI Service / AI Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Centralize AI calls in an internal service rather than calling OpenRouter from every part of the code.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Model Gateway
nodes.rationale: Avoid dependence on one model; change/test models, per-task models (light for tagging, strong for itinerary reasoning), cost control.

nodes.label: Redis Cache & Temporary State
nodes.rationale: Not the primary DB; used for API caching, sessions, rate limiting, background jobs, temporary itinerary state, AI response caching, distributed locks for booking.

nodes.label: Integration Abstraction Layer
nodes.rationale: Swap providers by changing adapters instead of rewriting the booking engine; handles auth, mapping, retries, timeouts, errors, rate limits.

nodes.label: AI Should Not Be the Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Knowledge Base + Traveler Profile are source of truth; AI output validated against structured data and business rules (e.g. a 4-hour scenic drive cannot become 30 minutes).
nodes.norm_label: ai should not be the source of truth

nodes.label: Facts/Relevance/Intelligence/Constraints Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Structured data provides facts, ML provides relevance, LLM provides reasoning, business rules provide constraints.

hyperedges.label: AI Grounded in Source of Truth with Rule Validation
